gameDescriptionHtml:
Walk upon a new world and slay foes endangering it. Rogue: Genesia is an action rogue-lite game, where you fight relentless hordes consisting of hundreds and thousands of monsters, make your build, break the balance, defeat bosses and save one of the many worlds.

Fend against vast enemy forces, reaching hundreds of foes on screen at any given time! In this action rogue-lite, you play as Rog. Master of all weapons, Rog can use anything to slay his numerous foes. [i]Kill, grow stronger, and kill some more![/i]

Game Features

  • You define Rog’s adventure – You can choose which path Rog takes. Feel brave enough to take on a powerful foe, or would you prefer to rest at the shop? The choice is yours!
  • 60+ powerful artifacts to discover – On this journey, you’ll collect many unique and powerful artifacts that will greatly impact your game experience. Harness their power to help you on your quest!
  • Different avatars with different playstyles! – Do you prefer guns, swords or having an army of summons kill your enemies for you?
